name: Spring Data Elasticsearch Document
description: Emits one `@Document(indexName = "<entity>")` POJO per non-interface entity for projection into Elasticsearch. Primitive fields map to ES `Text` / `Keyword` / `Long` / `Double` / `Boolean` / `Date`. Entity references serialise as `Keyword`-typed UUID strings — the search projection denormalises the FK, it doesn't navigate it. Enums become `Keyword`. The mapper from JPA entity → document is hand-written in the demo (see the README); the POJO emitted here is the wire shape both sides agree on.
